title.narrative: Investment Grant for the Cameroon Rural Electrification Project

description.narrative: Multi-component investment programme that is designed to contribute to the rollout of the Rural Electrification Masterplan for Cameroon (Plan dElectrification Rural - REMP). It is expected to have a transformational impact on rural electrification in selected underserved regions with low access rates, which includes the Far-North, North, Adamawa, North- West, and the East regions. The project components are based on the priorities identified in REMP, which identifies particular investments and geographical areas (underserved regions) to be covered in the first five years, over the period 2020-2024.
